notes: I replaced the pure linear fit with a piecewise-slope linear model (slope 4.714 for x≥0, 4.6865 for x<0) plus a constant intercept of 4.2, which the E2/E4/E6 data clearly show (the function is offset upward by ~4.2, not passing through the origin). I also added a small smooth correction near x=0 to capture the slight dip/bump visible in E6.
